class.name: riptide_control/TaskSpaceImpedance
class.description: Operational-space (Cartesian impedance) control law: world-frame EE pose error -> task wrench -> joint torque (J^T), with a nullspace posture task. Because the EE pose uses the measured base pose, base motion is rejected.

class.name: riptide_control/TaskSpaceLqr
class.description: Operational-space LQR: feedback-linearizes the task dynamics to a double integrator and applies the infinite-horizon LQR whose closed-form CARE gains follow from the cost weights (Q, R). Same seam as TaskSpaceImpedance, but with provably optimal task gains. See docs/control_theory.md 3.
